title: Bayes-Adaptive MDPs for Rollout Allocation to Enhance GRPO Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.37429v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has demonstrated strong performance in LLM post-training. However, it allocates a uniform rollout budget to every training question, ignoring variations in question difficulty. As a result, highly difficult questions may receive too few rollouts to generate informative positive reward signals, limiting their contribution to training, while moderately difficult questions often receive more rollouts than necessary. In this work, we formulate the problem of difficulty-aware rollout budget allocation to maximize training utility under the same total rollout budget as standard GRPO. translated_title: 基于贝叶斯自适应马尔可夫决策过程的Rollout分配方法以增强GRPO训练
translated_abstract: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）在大语言模型后训练中展现出了强大的性能。然而，它为每个训练问题分配统一的rollout预算，忽略了问题难度的差异。因此，高难度问题可能获得的rollout次数过少，无法产生有信息量的正向奖励信号，限制了其对训练的贡献；而中等难度问题往往获得的rollout次数多于实际所需。在本工作中，我们将难度感知的rollout预算分配问题进行形式化，目标是在与标准GRPO相同的总rollout预算下最大化训练效用。我们提出AdaRoll-GRPO，该方法将rollout分配重新表述为一个序贯决策问题，并利用贝叶斯自适应马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）来学习自适应的分配策略。学习到的策略通过离线方式计算得出，并在GRPO训练过程中直接应用，无需引入额外的在线优化。
tldr: 本文提出AdaRoll-GRPO，将GRPO训练中的rollout预算分配建模为贝叶斯自适应马尔可夫决策过程，实现基于问题难度的自适应rollout分配，在相同总预算下最大化训练效用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AdaRoll-GRPO, which reformulates rollout budget allocation in GRPO training as a Bayes-adaptive MDP to learn an adaptive difficulty-aware allocation policy, maximizing training utility under the same total rollout budget.
